hero_tagline: are getting married in the hills of Umbria
welcome_text: Join us for three golden days in the heart of *Umbria* — a thousand-year-old castle, long Italian dinners, sunshine by the pool, and the day we say "I do"
strip_text: Drinks, limoncello & dancing under the Umbrian stars — join us for the full weekend
hero_location: 20 August 2027 · Tenuta di Forte Sorgnano · Umbria

landscape.heading: The Hills of Umbria
landscape.text: Cypress trees, olive groves, medieval hilltops and a slower pace of life. August in Umbria is golden in every sense of the word.
